scope: Official native-PDF API/source investigation; no application/service/shared environment changes and no GPU execution

recommended_comparison.input: original same-byte PDFs; target same fourteen original pages plus 1225475375 physical p62; full scope and scored subset must be stated separately

default_behavior.auto_mode: PDFDocument.classify() determines txt or ocr before analysis
default_behavior.native_body: txt mode excludes text/title/header/footer/page number/footnotes/captions from VLM transcription, then fills spans from source PDF character geometry
default_behavior.standard_native_tables: Small-model layout and table orientation; medium/high txt attempts DocVortex recover_table_region using PDF characters/vector geometry. Accepted HTML tables removed from high VLM blocks; failed/rejected/complex tables retain model fallback. Advanced xhigh does not enter this native table priority step.
default_behavior.standard_image_analysis: high inference forces image_analysis=False; xhigh forwards the configured value
default_behavior.Markdown_default: result.markdown() DEFAULT renderer excludes PAGE_AUXILIARY_BLOCK_TYPES; result.markdown(add_markers=True) uses official FULL mode preserving those blocks and physical-page view. Both outputs retained separately in the experiment.

fallback_and_limits: Unreadable/private-use or sparse native spans may use post-OCR; over 65535 chars per page triggers OCR fallback.
Native table failure/low confidence/complex image-chart-code contents retain VLM fallback; no promise every table uses PDF-native text.
Layout misses, incorrect character maps and reading order still require independent original-PDF verification.
Ligatures and control characters receive official normalization; txt is not an absolute byte-for-byte transcription guarantee.

source_contract.public_result: MiddleJson page_idx/block bbox and HTML table contents; HTML spans can represent rowspan/colspan
source_contract.reason: Internal NativeTableResult has cells/geometry/source_char_indices; public DocVortex PDFTableResult projects to html/source/confidence/diagnostics before MinerU. MinerU tables.py then assigns table_block[content]=result.html only. Native HTML uses td with rowspan/colspan but no header-role flags.
source_contract.integration_limit: Do not fabricate cell geometry/header roles or remove repeated headers when full header evidence is unknown; preserve physical-page ModelJson when adapting existing table-source.

recommended_comparisons.purpose: native body + native table priority, visual fallback
native body + visual tables, without native table priority

selection_claim: Source inspection defined two official paths. Their execution evidence is separate, with original fourteen selected pages and additional p62 kept distinct; source inspection alone does not establish a winning path.
measured_experiment_evidence: official-native-comparison-summary.json; independent acceptance evidence supplied separately by source_acceptance_corpus
